Observed and predicted galaxy data

All rows from the joint audit. “Train”, “test” and “reserved” preserve analysis splits; these data have already been inspected and are not a new blind test. The formulas do not match every observation.

Redshift is a dimensionless wavelength ratio. Rotation is speed around the galaxy. Vertical pull is gravity toward the disk from above or below, expressed as |Kz|/(2πG). Milky Way stellar profiles and published vertical-force estimates retain model assumptions. The adjusted-stars model is a post-result repair experiment. Capture mass is fitted, not derived from the available photon energy.
